# PhotosStyle

> > PhotosStyle is an AI-powered photo transformation platform offering 40+ artistic styles, advanced image enhancement, and batch processing with support for models like ByteDance Seedream 4.5 and Google Nano Banana Pro.

PhotosStyle enables users to convert photos into various artistic styles including anime, pop art, 3D illustrations, and celebrity lookalikes. The platform supports multiple image formats (JPG, PNG, WebP) and provides tools for upscaling to 4K resolution, batch processing up to 20 images, and creating social media content for Instagram and TikTok.

## Key Topics

- AI photo transformation
- Seedream 4.5 (ByteDance)
- Nano Banana Pro (Google Gemini 2.5 Flash)
- 4K image upscaling
- Batch image processing
- Reference control & character consistency
- Anime style conversion (Pokemon, Sailor Moon, K-pop)
- Art style generators (Pop Art, Cubism, 3D Illustration)
- Celebrity lookalike finder
- Social media content (Instagram, TikTok)
- Multi-format support (JPG, PNG, WebP)
- Street art & graffiti generation
- Doll & emoji generators
- Comic book & poster design

- [Google Nano Banana Pro - Générateur d'Images IA Ultra Rapide](https://www.photosstyle.com/fr/model/nano-banana-pro): Google Gemini 2.5 Flash ultra-fast 1-2 second 4K image generator
